WINDOW / 02

Maintenance settings

Times are always IST (UTC+05:30)
Safety first. Saving settings does not turn maintenance on. The selected window is armed only after an explicit, verified administrator confirmation. Server writes are blocked only during the active window.

What happens to users?

During maintenance, visitors see the ByteQuest connection page with your message and expected return time. Signed-in library administrators can access the control panel. Existing browser drafts are not erased; cloud saves and submissions are not accepted during the active window.
